question: The value of a residential flat constructed at a cost of ₹10,00,000 is depreciating at a rate of 10% per annum. What will be its value 3 years after the construction
solution:
**Given:**

The value of a residential flat constructed at a cost of ₹10,00,000 is depreciating at a rate of 10% per annum.

**Formula used:**

Present value = P((100-r)/(100) )^n,

Where P is the initial value,

R is the rate at which the value is decreasing annually and

n is time in years. 

**Calculation:**

Present value,

⇒ 1000000((100-10)/(100) )³=1000000( 0.9 )³=729000

**∴ The value of the residential flat after 3 years is Rs. 729000**
